recurringPatterns.pattern: Sections and chapters almost invariably close on a small concrete object or anonymous figure (closing-object tic)
instances: The reed marker lies beside the pit, bent but unbroken.
The last worker leaving the road crew carried no battlefield trophy, only the dust of the path and the knowledge that the official would return.

recurringPatterns.pattern: The 'it can show X / it cannot show Y' evidential couplet as default paragraph engine
instances: It can show repeated blows and the presence of children among the dead. It cannot decide whether the killing was an act of revenge...
A court register may be strong evidence that a dispute was heard and weak evidence that most disputes reached court.

recurringPatterns.pattern: Negation-then-correction thesis sentences carrying nearly every summary claim
instances: Early states did not simply make people violent or peaceful; they made coercion legible, collectible, punishable, and deployable at a new scale.
Industrial modernity did not make people aggressive by changing an inner human substance. It changed what governments and movements could do...

recurringPatterns.pattern: Each chapter terminates in a single free-standing aphoristic verdict sentence on the same concessive-then-qualify frame
instances: Medieval religious and honor-bound worlds did not remove political calculation from violence; they gave calculation additional languages...
Early modern power made violence more administratively reliable, but reliability could mean protection at home, conquest abroad, or both at once.

recurringPatterns.pattern: Identical internal chapter architecture: dramatized scene, definitional inventory, canonical case, steelmanned rival explanation, narrowed verdict
instances: The strongest objection to this argument is that formal law marked a broad humanitarian advance.
The strongest rival explanation of medieval religious violence begins with doctrine.

summary: Disciplined historical methodology; reasoning standout; cost is engagement and pacing; lexical slop absent, structural templating heavy (paired antitheses, can/cannot couplets, negation-then-correction verdicts, uniform paragraphs, closing image at every seam).
